title: Cholesteric liquid crystal, 12 pitches, reflection band
source: C.-L. Ting, T.-H. Lin, C.-C. Liao, A. Y. G. Fuh, Opt. Express 14, 5594-5606 (2006), Fig. 2
notes: Given: n_e 1.616, n_o 1.494, pitch 338 nm, thickness 12 pitches (128 sublayers per pitch; the program reports how much doubling them changes the result). Not given, and assumed: normal incidence, unpolarised light (the figure's peak near 0.5 suggests it; unpolarised R is the mean of R_p and R_s), right-handed helix (unpolarised R does not depend on it), and outer media of the mean index 1.555 so that only the helix reflects. The paper's approximate band: centre n P = 525.6 nm, width (n_e - n_o) P = 41.2 nm, edges n_o P = 505.0 and n_e P = 546.2 nm. The director starts along x: the material's optic axis (principal z) is turned to x by Euler [90, 90, 0], and the twist turns it about z.
